nativeSourceResponse.method: Actual captured compact diagonal/offdiagonal retained in every momentum solve. nativeSourceResponse.limitations: This decomposes one linear map response at its retained observed mode. A large source contribution is not proof of a unique instability cause. It is not a spectrum bound, a physical field, an accuracy repair, or a term-deletion counterfactual.
nativeSourceResponse.consumer: Focused native coupling/stress investigation. Complete modal input and output plus native matrix/gradient traces permit replay; rebuilt binaries and repeated full CSV views remain temporary.
